body:
### DTS
- The app now asks the TV whether it decodes DTS. If it does, DTS plays without conversion and you see "native DTS" instead of "This TV can't play DTS".
- **Dolby Vision + DTS (experimental):** with DTS conversion **Off** on a TV that decodes DTS (e.g. LG C3/C4), Dolby Vision files with a DTS track now keep Dolby Vision instead of dropping to HDR10. The full DTS stream (DTS-HD MA / DTS:X) goes to the TV and your soundbar.
- TVs that need DTS conversion work as before.

### Playback
- Embedded image subtitles (PGS) no longer end Dolby Vision/DTS playback after a few minutes.
- Audio from another version: no more 40-second freeze and fallback after the automatic intro skip.

### Diagnostics
- **Download log** now says why the local log page could not open (for example, no local network address).
- The log page also works on TVs with a 100.x.x.x address (some internet providers and VPNs).
- **Send to cloud:** if the local page cannot open, press OK (or RIGHT when it works) to upload the redacted log. The TV shows a QR code and a link, valid for 72 hours.

### Known
- Image subtitles (PGS) are still not displayed during Dolby Vision conversion.

### Tested
- **LG C3 (native DTS):** the TV reports DTS support. Dolby Vision P7 → 8.1 with DTS-HD MA / DTS:X plays in Dolby Vision, with sound through the soundbar.
- **LG C5 (no DTS):** the TV reports no DTS, so conversion works as before. Dolby Vision P7 with DTS converted to AAC, and Dolby Vision with AC-3, both play correctly.

**If you run into a problem while testing, here's how to send me a log:**
1. Settings → About and help → Log → turn on "Diagnostics QR".
2. Reproduce the problem.
3. Press RED on the remote (log panel), then BLUE → "Download log".
4. Open the shown address on your phone (same Wi-Fi) and send the file to me (Matis) on Discord.
   If it says "Could not open the local address", press OK (or RIGHT) to upload to the cloud and send me the link (valid 72 h).
Please add: TV model, what you played (DV/HDR10, DTS/TrueHD/AC-3), your DTS setting and what went wrong.
name: Nuvio Legacy webOS 2.0.8.7 test build2

body: **External audio test** **Audio from another version** - Play the picture of one source with the audio of another video file of the same title. Works with MKV, MP4, AVI and TS. - Automatic sync within ±60 min, manual sync (10 ms to 10 min steps, CH+/CH-), frame rate correction. - New: “Follow through the whole film” for another cut: plays the file’s own audio in scenes the other version lacks. - Smoother intro skip with a retry when the source is slow. - All options in one sheet: Settings > Playback > “Audio from another version” (OK opens it). **Note:** - The audio source is streamed over its own connection, so a smaller file needs less bandwidth. - "Follow through the whole movie" option is in early release and is not yet fully refined. - "Match automatically" the matching process takes about 40 seconds. Test build, installs over the regular 2.0.8.7.
name: Nuvio Legacy webOS 2.0.8.7 test build

body:
### DTS output

- Added an **Off** option to the DTS output setting, next to Stereo (AAC) and 5.1 (Dolby Digital). With Off, DTS is not converted and files with only DTS audio play on the TV's own player.
- Preserved Dolby Vision playback with AC-3/E-AC-3 audio when DTS conversion is off.
- Kept saved Stereo (AAC) and 5.1 (Dolby Digital) choices unchanged.

### HDR10 and Dolby Vision 8 with DTS

- Fixed broken or garbled pictures in HDR10 and Dolby Vision 8 files with DTS audio by keeping the stream's own HEVC parameter sets.
- Recovered DTS tracks missing from the LG audio list, so they can be selected from the file, including multiple DTS tracks in the same language.
- Improved handling of Dolby Vision 8 detected after playback starts, keeping audio and picture routing in sync.
- Recovered full native decoder queues instead of stalling playback.
- Added experimental HDR10+ SEI handling for DTS/Dolby Vision playback.

### Seeking and audio switching

- Quick seeks no longer reload the picture.
- Switching between DTS tracks no longer reloads the picture.
- The latest seek or track change is applied when several are made in a row.

### DTS/TrueHD and DV7 buffering

- **Standard (1)** now uses the Tizen method: one continuous HTTP connection instead of a new request every 4 MB. Based on Tizen work in iqui27/nuvio-native-legacy#537. thanks @Namer03
- **Standard (1)** is now the default for DTS/TrueHD and DV7 buffering.
- Native-player buffering is unchanged.

### Audio track names

- The top line of each audio track now shows the language (for example "French"), with codec and channels below ("DTS 5.1"), for DTS, TrueHD, AC-3 and other codecs.
- FLAC tracks keep the track name from the file, for example commentaries. If that name is only the release name, the language is shown instead.
- Long track names are no longer cut early; they are shortened only at the edge of the menu.
- Removed "DTS" from the format badge next to Dolby Vision.

### Diagnostics and translations

- Diagnostics logs are available at a stable address on the local network, shown as a plain URL without a QR code.
- Added translations in 29 languages for Dolby Vision P7 mapping, Dolby Vision MP4, Dolby Vision audio output and the Buffer screen.

Based on this [branch](https://github.com/Matis94/nuvio-native-legacy/tree/Nuvio_webOS_2.0.8.7)
name: Nuvio Legacy webOS 2.0.8.7

body:
### Source-list performance

- Improved scrolling smoothness and responsiveness with large source lists, including 2,000+ sources.
- Optimized source sorting, filtering and repeated evaluations to reduce unnecessary processing.
- Improved rendering efficiency by skipping formatter elements outside the visible area.
- Reduced unnecessary background redraws while preserving metadata and artwork updates.
- Moved badge-data copying to background workers, reducing UI-thread blocking and temporary memory usage.
- Improved frame synchronization in the source-selection window while waiting for a stream, matching the pacing used on the title-details page.
- Preserved existing player pacing after selecting a source, including playback, seeking and retained video.
- Added fallback to the existing frame limiter if VSync cannot be enabled.
- Disabled detailed source-list performance diagnostics after testing, removing their runtime measurement state. Regular application and playback logs remain active.

### Audio track memory

- Improved remembered audio-track matching across episodes, including automatic next-episode playback.
- Prevented incorrect audio-track selection when a different track occupies the same position.
- Preserved per-series and per-profile audio preferences.
- Added language-based fallback when the preferred audio track is unavailable.

### Badges and formatter

- Fixed inconsistent badge styles appearing within the same source list.
- Improved compatibility with imported badge packs, including custom colors, backgrounds, outlines and transparency.
- Extended support for longer badge-matching expressions and scoped regex modifiers.
- Reduced badge flickering and layout shifts during texture loading and cache recovery.
- Added **Badge position (From addon)** with **Top** and **Bottom** options. **Top** remains the default.
- Improved formatter text and emoji alignment during scrolling.

### Source loading

- Prevented duplicate source requests when incoming episode metadata matches an already active request.
- Preserved immediate asynchronous source loading and upstream episode metadata improvements from PRs **#614** and **#576**.
- Maintained support for manual refreshes and source requests for different episodes.

### Profile selection

- Added **Remember last profile**, disabled by default.
- When enabled, automatically opens the last available unlocked profile at startup.
- Preserved manual profile switching and existing PIN protection.
- Stores the preference locally on the TV.

### Skip-button visibility

- Added independent **Show intro skip button**, **Show recap skip button** and **Show outro / credits skip button** settings.
- All three options are enabled by default.
- Individual buttons can be hidden, including while playback controls are open.
- Button visibility is independent of automatic skipping and does not change next-episode playback.
- Preferences are saved separately for each profile on the TV.

### Build cleanup

- Removed temporary diagnostic and VSync test-build shortcuts and restored normal regression-test selection.
- Preserved full application compilation, ARM compatibility checks and IPK packaging.

Based on this [branch](https://github.com/Matis94/nuvio-native-legacy/tree/Nuvio_webOS_2.0.8.6)
name: Nuvio Legacy webOS 2.0.8.6

body:
**Experimental build — webOS test updates **

- Made locally saved **Continue Watching** entries appear before remote synchronization finishes.
- Expanded offline emoji support for addon formatters.
- Improved source-list performance with lazy formatting and a bounded cache for large lists.
- Improved **From addon** source cards with rich formatting, language flags, emojis, and preserved DUAL/MULTI labels.
- Improved next-episode source matching to follow the currently playing release, including when using Next in manual source mode.
- Improved season-tab availability and episode-list cache refresh behavior.
- Improved **SDR/DTS buffering** by reusing resolved CDN URLs and recovering expired links.
- Improved audio-language filtering when declared audio metadata is missing, keeping subtitle languages separate.
- Added full filename wrapping in both **From Nuvio** and **From addon** views.
- Added subtitle opacity adjustments in **5% steps**, preserving existing preferences.
- Added a separate **Diagnostics QR** switch, **OFF by default**. Normal logging remains active, and temporary QR export resources are released when closed.
- Added detailed network diagnostics for redirects, transfer timing, rate limits, and connection reuse, with sensitive information redacted.
- Added shared HTTP 429 cooldowns that respect the server’s `Retry-After` response.
- Added earlier recovery for stalled **Dolby Vision** fragments while retaining successfully downloaded data.

**Additional updates — 2.0.8.5 (stable version)**

- Fixed wrapped filenames being shortened with an ellipsis during panel animations, hiding characters before the continuation on the next line.
- Fixed automatic next-episode playback opening the source-selection page despite a matching release being available. The first episode can still be selected manually; subsequent episodes follow the playing release when a match is found.
- Fixed the first source card’s top border disappearing during scrolling. The outline stays visible below the addon tabs.
- Fixed duplicate filenames when the formatter removes the [Cloud] prefix.
- Improved scrolling performance on large source lists by avoiding repeated filtering and sorting when newly visible cards are measured.
- Improved episode titles from cloud metadata: release filenames are replaced with available metadata titles or a localized “Episode 1” fallback.
- Added Update notifications in Settings. Disabling it hides automatic update notices and panels while keeping manual update checks available.
- Preserved episode identifiers, season numbering, source URLs and release matching.
- Updated the installation label and IPK filename to **2.0.8.5 (stable version)**.

**Additional updates2 — 2.0.8.5 (stable version)**

- Improved DTS/TrueHD and Dolby Vision buffer recovery after seeking and temporary download slowdowns.
- Prioritized missing fragments needed for playback while retaining downloads that are still making useful progress.
- Improved buffering-state reporting during recovery and blocked network reads.
- Added separate HTTP connection controls for native playback and DTS/TrueHD/DV7 processing inside **Buffer size**: Standard (1), Parallel 2, 3 or 4.
- Preserved defaults: **1 connection for native playback**, **4 connections for conversion**.
- Added recommendation labels for conversion: **4 recommended**, **1 not recommended**.
- Added the active session’s HTTP connection limit to Buffer data, with subdued text and wrapping for longer information.
- Extended converter URL support and remembered Dolby Vision audio-source URLs to **8,191 bytes**, preventing truncation of long addon links.
- Fixed stale loading indicators remaining visible after playback starts or after seeking, while preserving indicators for genuine buffering.
- Added regression coverage for startup, seeking, session changes, audio switching and buffer recovery.
- Updated the DV handoff test to match the corrected loading-state behavior.

Based on this [branch](https://github.com/Matis94/nuvio-native-legacy/tree/Nuvio_webOS_test)

body:
**Experimental build — Playback improvements (v11)**

This is an experimental version intended for testing.

- Restored RAM read-ahead buffering for regular HTTP/HTTPS streams, with buffer usage and buffered-range reporting.
- Improved seeking within buffered content while retaining existing RAM limits and buffer protections.
- Added native seek reuse for compatible DTS and Dolby Vision playback, with automatic reload fallback if seeking stalls.
- Fixed the progress bar briefly jumping backwards before reaching the selected position.
- Improved Dolby Vision Profile 7 → Profile 8.1 conversion reliability and startup handling.
- Reduced Dolby Vision interruptions during seeking on the conversion pipeline.
- Improved DTS startup, resume and seeking behavior, removing the black-screen issue confirmed during SDR/DTS testing.
- Prevented the movie poster and opening overlay from reappearing during DTS/DV seeks and audio changes.
- Fixed stale loading indicators remaining visible after playback had started.
- Changed the DTS conversion notification to appear once per source instead of repeating after seeking.
- Added experimental TrueHD conversion to AAC stereo or AC-3 5.1 while preserving Dolby Vision after audio switching.
- Added a separate TrueHD conversion notification, shown only when the selected TrueHD track is being converted.
- Preserved native playback routing for Dolby Vision profiles that do not require P7 conversion.
- Added downloadable diagnostic logs through a QR code, with sensitive information redacted.
- Added temporary RAM and buffer diagnostics. The RAM overlay is hidden by default and can be toggled with the green remote button.
- Added regression tests for seeking, loading overlays, audio selection, conversion notifications and Dolby Vision/TrueHD playback.
- Built and verified the complete ARM IPK, including P2P support.

**Note:** TrueHD conversion does not preserve lossless audio or Atmos metadata.

**TODO**

- Investigate and fix the brief black screen when switching audio tracks during Dolby Vision playback, including changes between native and converted audio formats.

**How to test**

For high-bitrate remuxes, select a **128 MiB or 256 MiB buffer** in the playback settings before starting the movie.

- **SDR + DTS:** Open an SDR movie with a DTS audio track. Test startup, resume and seeking within and beyond the buffered range. Check for black screens, the movie poster reappearing or loading indicators remaining visible. The DTS conversion notification should appear once per source.
- **Dolby Vision P7 → P8.1 with supported audio:** Enable P7 conversion and open a P7 movie with an AC-3 or E-AC-3 track. Confirm Dolby Vision activates, then test seeking and buffered-range reporting.
- **Dolby Vision P7 → P8.1 + DTS:** Open a P7 movie and select its DTS track. Confirm Dolby Vision remains active and audio plays correctly. Test seeking and check that the conversion notification does not repeat.
- **Dolby Vision P7 → P8.1 + TrueHD:** Select a TrueHD track. Confirm Dolby Vision remains active, converted audio plays correctly and the TrueHD conversion notification appears. Test seeking and switching between TrueHD, DTS and AC-3/E-AC-3 tracks where available.
- **Regular HTTP/HTTPS playback:** Open a movie that requires neither DV conversion nor DTS conversion. Check that the buffer fills, the buffered range appears on the progress bar and seeking works correctly.
- **RAM overlay and logs:** Use the green remote button to show or hide the RAM overlay. If an issue occurs, export the diagnostic log using the QR code and include the selected video/audio format and the action that triggered the problem.

body:
## LG webOS 2.0.6 — Test Build 8

Based on Nuvio Native Legacy 2.0.6, with additional playback fixes and features for LG webOS.

### Playback improvements

- Improved DTS playback stability, reducing video freezes, audio dropouts and unnecessary stream reloads.
- Added bounded recovery for DTS timestamp discontinuities.
- Added handling of short forward audio timestamp gaps without restarting the entire playback pipeline.
- Added retries for failed HTTP byte ranges while preserving successfully prefetched data.
- Added earlier retries for actively awaited, stalled downloads to reduce buffer starvation.
- Improved seeking by reusing the open source, reducing unnecessary connection setup.
- Prevented stale playback callbacks from triggering false “Failed to open source” errors.

### Dolby Vision

- Experimental Dolby Vision Profile 7 → Profile 8.1 conversion.
- Conversion retains the base layer and converts RPU metadata; the enhancement layer is discarded. Full FEL reconstruction is not supported.

### Buffer and diagnostics

- Selectable movie download buffer: **System (off), 64, 128 or 256 MiB**.
- Download buffer support for compatible native movie streams.
- Player buffer indicator showing downloaded data and estimated buffered time.
- Optional RAM overlay, toggled with the **GREEN** remote button.
- Sanitized diagnostic log export through a local QR download, as described below.

### Source list

- Improved full filename display in both **“From the addon”** and **“From Nuvio”** modes.
- Added text wrapping for selected sources, including long filenames and UTF-8 characters.

### Local diagnostic log export

Download a sanitized diagnostic log directly from the TV to your phone over your **local network**.

1. Connect your phone to the **same local network** as the TV.
2. After the issue occurs, press **RED** on the remote to open the log panel.
3. While the log panel is open, press **BLUE** to display the QR code.
4. Scan the QR code with your phone and download the `.txt` log file.

Keep the QR screen open until the download finishes. The file is a snapshot taken when the export is opened, so export it **after reproducing the issue or completing your playback test**.

This QR export transfers the log directly over your local network; it does not upload it to GitHub or an external log server.

### Notes

- Experimental custom build, tested on an **LG OLED C5**, including extended DTS and 4K Dolby Vision P7 playback.
- Playback compatibility and available memory depend on the TV, firmware and source.
name: Nuvio Legacy webOS 2.0.6

body:
# Test build for LG WebOs

- Added a local **Movie download buffer (test)** setting: 64 MiB (default), 128 MiB, 256 MiB, or System (off).
- Applied the selected compressed-payload budget to DTS/Dolby Vision HTTP range reads.
- Added a loopback byte cache for ordinary progressive HTTP(S) movies, including playback without DTS or Dolby Vision; native audio/video decoding is retained.
- Preserved authenticated upstream headers, exact byte ranges and seeking. Unsupported origins and manifest sources fall back to native playback before media bytes are sent.
- Added ready-data / capacity MiB to the player controls and extended the gray timeline with an estimated cache duration. Other paths display **Buffer: system**.
- Added GREEN remote-button toggling of the saved RAM overlay preference; RED retains its log action. RAM display remains disabled by default.
- Added a separate **Dolby Vision P7 to P8.1 (experimental)** setting, enabled by default in this test build. The original MKV Dolby Vision option controls P5/P8 independently.
- Preserved P7 MEL/FEL-to-P8.1 conversion: unchanged base HEVC video, converted RPU, discarded enhancement layer.
- Preserved full focused filenames with UTF-8-safe wrapping in both source-text modes.
- Retained P2P, ASS subtitles, DTS audio conversion, firmware adapters and application service configuration.

HLS/DASH, live and existing loopback/P2P paths use system/own buffering. The new cache does not reconstruct FEL or impose a total-process RAM limit. Sustained playback requires testing on the TV.
name: Nuvio Legacy webOS 2.0.5
